title: Night Market Poster and Reel
tests: Completes both linked deliverables from one message: a still poster and a matching animated reel, preserving exact event details in both.

faults.what: No separate finished still poster is supplied in the evidence; all four images are frames from the same reel.
The supplied sound report identifies speech, “Schauen wir mal.”, contrary to the explicit no-sound requirement, although the reported peak level is very low.

judge.summary: The reel has attractive warm illustrations, readable event text, and subtle animation, but a separate poster is not shown and the sound report flags unwanted speech.

must_haves.item: Two separate finished assets are supplied: a still poster and an eight-second video reel, both vertical 9:16.
must_haves.why: An eight-second reel with a visibly approximately 9:16 vertical frame is evidenced, but no separate still poster is supplied.

must_haves.item: Both assets contain all five specified text strings, spelled exactly as requested.
must_haves.why: All five strings are exact and readable in every supplied reel frame; the separate poster cannot be inspected.

must_haves.item: Both show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights with a visibly matching palette and design.
must_haves.why: The reel clearly shows warm illustrated food stalls and string lights in amber and dark navy, but no separate poster is available for comparison.

must_haves.item: The reel has visible background animation while all event details remain readable throughout.
must_haves.why: Steam shapes and glowing particles visibly change between frames while all five event details remain stable, unobscured, and readable.

must_haves.item: The reel has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound transcription reports speech, despite the very low reported peak level.
